lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And where are those items you said you saw?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like right underneath there.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Underneath the bag?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”)Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well, how would you see that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well, if the bags like that far off the you know the top of the thing you can see though underneath it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You could see underneath it? (Brendan nods “yes”) What did you see?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: like a cell phone, camera, purse

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Are you being honest with us?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”)Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you actually see those items?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”)Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When did you see them?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: When I came over there with the mail.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Before you went into the house (Brendan nods “yes”) or after you went into the house?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Before I went into the house.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you look in there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Because it was full and it usually ain’t.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK.
